claim_or_location: Co-localisation rho computed on raw q05 abundances; notes conclude 'both pre-stated hypotheses supported' (MES-like~myeloid, OPC-like~oligodendroglial lineage).
evidence: Every class is positively correlated with the spot's total q05 abundance (median across 21 DMG sections of rho(class,total): OPC-like 0.44, AC-like 0.55, OC-like 0.46, MES-like 0.30, myeloid 0.48, astrocyte 0.46, oligodendrocyte 0.29), and total q05 tracks UMI depth (rho with n_counts 0.13-0.92 per section). Consequently 28/30 state x TME pairs are positive and 25/30 have q<0.05. Re-pooled (same DL on Fisher z, 21 sections) on per-spot proportions: AC-like~astrocyte 0.43 -> 0.21 (13/21 positive, q=0.016); OC-like~oligodendrocyte 0.36 -> 0.21 (q=0.022); OC-like~neuron 0.32 -> 0.24; MES-like~myeloid 0.30 -> 0.175 (14/21, p=0.007, q=0.023); OPC-like~T/NK 0.29 -> 0.03 (p=0.72); OPC-like~oligodendrocyte 0.25 -> 0.06 (p=0.36). Partial Spearman controlling log(total q05): AC~astro 0.24, MES~myeloid 0.15 (p=0.003), OPC~oligo 0.13 (p=0.027, 15/21), OPC~T/NK 0.04 (p=0.55). Pairs reported as 'null' are in fact negative once density is removed: OPC-like~astrocyte -0.27 (proportions, 3/21 positive) / -0.19 (partial).
impact_on_conclusions: Magnitudes in §4 and in the colocalisation matrix figure are roughly doubled by a shared cell-density/UMI-depth component. MES-like~myeloid survives with a smaller effect (0.15-0.18). The second pre-stated hypothesis (OPC-like with oligodendroglial lineage) is weak-to-null after adjustment (0.06-0.13) and OPC-like~T/NK disappears. The statement 'both pre-stated hypotheses are supported' is not defensible as written.
recommendation: Report proportion-based (or CLR/partial) correlations as primary, raw as secondary; restate §4 and Fig. 5d accordingly; add OPC-like~astrocyte segregation as a result rather than 'null'.

claim_or_location: §4: within section, higher tumour fraction goes with a larger OPC-like share (rho=0.35, 10/10). §10 reports the MP-reference result for OC-like (0.36, 10/10) and says MES-like 'replicates' but does not say that OPC-like does not.
evidence: Recomputed: fallback OPC-like share RE rho 0.347 (0.251-0.437), 10/10; MP-reference OPC-like share -0.028 (-0.124-0.069), 5/10 (log line 18:41:27). Spot-level Spearman between the two runs: OPC-like q05 0.70 (lowest of all classes), whereas fallback OPC-like vs MP OC-like = 0.96. MP malignant shares: OC-like 0.19 vs fallback OC-like 0.06. The 'Spearman 0.98' agreement claim is for tumour fraction only (recomputed 0.976 over 10 sections; 0.987 over 34,939 spots); per-state agreement is 0.70-0.99.
impact_on_conclusions: The state-specific brainstem conclusion depends on how the malignant reference classes are defined: what the fallback calls OPC-like is what the MP reference calls OC-like/COP. Readers of §4 would take 'OPC-like enriched in the core' as a finding; §10 silently swaps the label.
recommendation: State explicitly in §10 that the OPC-like within-section effect does not replicate (−0.03) and that fallback OPC-like maps to MP OC-like (spot rho 0.96); report per-class agreement, not only tumour fraction.

claim_or_location: 'All four ELBO traces had plateaued: the last 5 % of epochs reduced the ELBO by 0.07–0.16 % of the total reduction'. Brainstem and Ren were budget-capped at 8,185 and 9,750 epochs (target 20,000).
evidence: The script writes out/<cohort>_history.csv but none of the four deconvolution histories (nor brainstem_mp_history.csv) exists anywhere in the repository (find . -name '*history*': only models/c2l_regression/signatures_history.csv and results/tables/c2l_signatures_mp_history.csv). Only final_elbo is recorded in the run json. The two RegressionModel histories that do exist show convergence (last 5 % of 250 epochs = 0.05 % / 0.06 % of the total ELBO reduction).
impact_on_conclusions: The plateau claim for the deconvolution runs cannot be checked from the repo; brainstem and Ren ran at 41 % / 49 % of the intended epochs. Posterior q05 values from under-trained models are biased toward the prior (N_cells_per_location), which would depress abundances uniformly rather than change rank orders, so conclusions are unlikely to flip, but this is unverified.
recommendation: Harvest the five *_history.csv files into results/tables (or models/) and quote the plateau statistic from them; or re-run brainstem/ren to 20k epochs.

claim_or_location: Dominant-class maps of four sections (pDMG_Sample-2, DMG1, BT01_192_core_HE, Pons_A).
evidence: Spots are plotted at (array_col, -array_row) with aspect='equal'. On the Visium hex grid array_col steps are half the physical distance of array_row steps; for Ren DMG1 the array extent ratio is 1.65 vs 1.06 in full-resolution pixels (pxl_col/pxl_row, available in obs and obsm['spatial'] but unused) → tissue is stretched 1.56x horizontally. No section identifiers, no scale bar, no cohort labels anywhere (no caption exists in docs/figures.md or phase6_notes.md; the section picks are only in the log and script). Dominant-class argmax hides mixtures.

claim_or_location: Fallback malignant states = argmax of scanpy score_genes scores over 5 gene sets (Filbin/Liu).
evidence: Scores are not standardised before argmax; their means differ by >30x (OPC-like 0.306, AC-like 0.127, MES-like 0.043, OC-like 0.009, cycling -0.008; SDs 0.11-0.35). Result over 90,000 candidates: OPC-like 45,293, AC-like 19,903, MES-like 15,737, cycling 6,227, OC-like 1,420 (1.6 %), NA 1,420. A z-scored argmax gives OPC 24,574 / MES 21,990 / AC 15,955 / OC 14,355 / cycling 13,126 and agrees with the raw argmax for only 68.7 % of cells. The reference therefore has 1,420 OC-like vs 8,000 MES-like cells. Gene-centred log-signature correlations: AC-like vs MES-like 0.70, OPC-like vs OC-like 0.71 (collinear).
impact_on_conclusions: Class definitions driving every state-level spatial result (MES-like share, OC-like scarcity, OPC-like dominance) rest on an arbitrary scaling choice; MES-like at 17.5 % of DMG malignant cells is high for H3K27M DMG and likely absorbs hypoxic/reactive programmes (fallback MES-like vs MP hypoxia spot rho 0.56 in the brainstem). The §10 MP reference partly addresses this for the brainstem only.
recommendation: Document the scaling sensitivity; prefer the MP-family reference (or z-scored argmax with a margin) for all four cohorts, as already listed under Open items.

claim_or_location: All in-tissue spots are deconvolved; no spot-level UMI filter.
evidence: From obs n_counts: 1,633 of 69,118 spots (2.4 %) have <500 UMIs and 716 have <100; minima 1 (Spinal_Cord_A), 2 (DMG1), 5 (Spinal_Cord_B), 9 (Medulla_C), 12 (Midbrain). Spinal_Cord_A has 350 spots <100 UMIs (10 %) and 552 <500; Medulla_A has median 1,293 UMIs and 621 spots <1,000. Low-count spots receive floor q05 abundances (1st percentile 0.003-0.03 per class).
impact_on_conclusions: Proportion-based statistics in low-count spots are noise-dominated; concentrated in the caudal brainstem sections, i.e. in the sections that anchor the 'tumour fraction falls caudally' statement. Unlikely to reverse but adds noise and a depth gradient confound.
recommendation: Apply a minimal spot filter (e.g. >=500 UMIs or >=250 genes) or show sensitivity; report per-section depth alongside tumour fraction.

claim_or_location: Section-level trends (n=10): OPC-like rho=-0.70 p=0.025, OC-like -0.66, cycling -0.65, oligodendrocyte proportion 0.69 p=0.029.
evidence: All rho/p values reproduce exactly. 11 classes + tumour fraction x 2 metrics (abs, prop) = 24 Spearman tests on 10 points; no correction in §4. BH over the 12 abs p-values: min q 0.17; over the 12 prop p-values: min q 0.236. §10 applies BH but only to p_abs (q_bh_abs); the quoted oligodendrocyte 'proportion rho 0.72, p=0.019' is a p_prop and is uncorrected in both runs. Tumour-fraction trend itself: rho -0.52, p=0.13.
impact_on_conclusions: None of the brainstem trend statements is significant after multiplicity; they are descriptive (the notes do say 'single patient: descriptive'), but §4 presents nominal p-values without that caveat.
recommendation: Report q-values in §4 as in §10, and apply BH to both metrics or pre-specify one.

claim_or_location: Hyper-parameters stated but not justified.
evidence: N_cells_per_location=5 is the cell2location tutorial default for mouse brain; paediatric DMG and GBM sections are hypercellular (tens of cells per 55 µm spot). Median total q05 per spot is 1.5-5.7 cells across sections; total abundance correlates with UMI depth (per-section rho up to 0.92). No histology-based estimate and no sensitivity run.
impact_on_conclusions: Absolute abundances are on an arbitrary scale; only relative statements (shares, rank correlations) are defensible. The notes largely respect this, but 'tumour fraction' values (0.40-0.74) are shares of a prior-anchored total.
recommendation: State that absolute abundances are prior-anchored; if feasible, run one cohort with N_cells_per_location=20 to show rank stability.

claim_or_location: Reference composition by study/assay.
evidence: 59,940 cells: Okada 51.6 %, Jessa scRNA 22.4 %, Jessa multiome 17.7 %, Collot 5.9 %, Zang 1.8 %, DeSisto 0.6 %; snRNA 68.6 %, multiome 17.7 %, scRNA 13.7 %. Neuron class: 3,786/4,306 (88 %) Okada, 0 % scRNA; vascular 89 % snRNA; astrocyte 2 % scRNA. RegressionModel uses batch_key=sample_id with study and assay as categorical covariates, which is the recommended way to absorb this.
impact_on_conclusions: Reference is autopsy-nuclei dominated; TME signatures (neuron, vascular, astrocyte) are essentially single-study nuclear profiles applied to whole-cell Visium RNA. Handled by covariates; residual risk of under-detecting cytoplasm-rich transcripts is not quantified.
recommendation: Record the composition in the notes; no change required.

claim_or_location: DerSimonian-Laird over 21 DMG sections treated as independent; 10 are serial sections of one autopsy (34,939/52,774 = 66 % of DMG spots).
evidence: Patient structure: brainstem 10 sections/1 patient, Ren DMG 5/5, Collot 3/3 (only the core section of BT01_192 is in the Visium set; no edge section), Huchedé 3/3 → 21 sections ≈ 12 patients. I² = 0.986-0.997 for every pair, so the RE CI is driven by tau² (between-section) not by 1/(n-3); bootstrap CIs agree with RE CIs. Sensitivity (raw abundances): leave-brainstem-out AC~astro 0.55 (0.43-0.66), MES~myeloid 0.29 (0.02-0.52, p=0.035), OC~oligo 0.53; brainstem collapsed to one effective section: 0.53 / 0.29 / 0.50. The brainstem-only pooled values are consistently the smallest (AC~astro 0.28).
impact_on_conclusions: Pseudo-replication does not drive the headline pairs; it does inflate nominal precision (p_re) and the '21/21 sections positive' count (really 11 non-brainstem + 10 correlated).
recommendation: Report patient count alongside section count; add a leave-one-patient/cohort-out table.

claim_or_location: DMG vs GBM: tumour fraction 0.52 vs 0.38 (p=0.032); cycling share 0.12 vs 0.20 (p=0.008); no correction across 12 variables.
evidence: Reproduced: TF medians 0.516 / 0.384, exact MWU p=0.0317; cycling 0.115 / 0.195, p=0.0079 = the minimum attainable two-sided exact p for 5 vs 5 (U=0, complete separation). BH over the 12 tests: q=0.095 (cycling), 0.19 (TF). GBM out-group is heterogeneous (GBM1, GBM4 are IDH-mutant secondary GBM; DMG1, DMG4 recurrent) and is deconvolved with a DMG-derived malignant reference.
impact_on_conclusions: Statements are correctly hedged in the notes ('no multiple-testing correction'); nothing survives BH. The cycling difference may partly reflect reference mismatch (GBM states forced onto DMG signatures).
recommendation: Add q-values and the IDH status caveat.

claim_or_location: Within section, MES-like share falls with tumour fraction (rho=-0.36, 0/10 positive): 'MES-like enriched at the infiltrative edge'.
evidence: Reproduced exactly (−0.364, −0.474 to −0.242, 0/10). Robust to using posterior means instead of q05 (−0.384, 0/10) and replicates with the MP reference (−0.31, 1/10). Absolute MES-like q05 is flat against tumour fraction (RE rho −0.08, 5/10) while OPC/AC/OC-like rise (0.35-0.40), so the share effect is not a pure denominator artefact. Caveat: share and tumour fraction are both ratios of the same q05 vector; and the fallback MES-like class is broad (SP-06).
impact_on_conclusions: Finding is internally consistent and reference-robust; it remains one autopsy.
recommendation: Keep; note the compositional caveat.

claim_or_location: Within-section variance of Fisher z uses n_spots as independent observations.
evidence: Spots are spatially autocorrelated, so 1/(n−3) understates within-section variance by a large factor; however I² ≈ 0.99 and tau² (0.06-0.15) dominates the pooled variance, so the RE CIs and p_re are effectively between-section statistics and change little. BH is applied to the 30 DMG state×TME pairs only; the 11 within-section brainstem RE tests and the GBM pairs are uncorrected (p_re there are ≤1e-5 for the reported effects, so this is immaterial).
impact_on_conclusions: No material effect.
recommendation: Mention in methods.
